pages.text: Open the Crafting Terminal's $(thing)Stations tab$(). It has exactly two groups: $(thing)Processing Stations$() and $(thing)Instant Stations$(). Each group has its own arrows and mouse-wheel paging, and Search Stations filters both groups together.

Processing Stations include Furnace, Blast Furnace, Smoker, Campfire, Brewing Stand, and supported modded machines. Installed totals can exceed one normal stack. Hover the amount to see the exact installed variant and combined rate per tick.

Instant Stations include Crafting Table, Stonecutter, and Smithing Table. Each accepts at most one, can be removed, and unlocks matching recipes without a made-up energy amount. Modded instant stations appear when their recipe family is supported.

The $(thing)Transform tab$() is separate from Stations. It converts real input items into stored typed resources such as Fuel, Brew Energy, Axe Energy, or FE. Stored resources remain visible through the Storage resource selector.
